P304.succ.statement:
Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a\in\mathbb N$ and $K:X	imes X	o\mathbb C$, and assume given an instance of the project structure `KernelProofData a K` (per its docstring, data common through most of chapters 2 through 7). By its constructor this consists of: a `DoublingMeasure` $X\,(2^a)$ structure on $X$ — $X$ is complete and locally compact and carries a Borel measure $\mu$ (Lean's `volume`) which is locally finite, nonzero and doubling: $\mu(B(x,2r))\le 2^a\mu(B(x,r))$ for all $x\in X$, $r\in\mathbb R$ —; the condition $4\le a$; a `CompatibleFunctions` $\mathbb R\,X\,(2^a)$ structure (per its docstring, a compatible set $\Theta$ of continuous functions), which contains a `FunctionDistances` $\mathbb R\,X$ structure: a type $\Theta(X)$ with an injective map from $\Theta(X)$ to the continuous functions $X	o\mathbb R$ (through which we apply $\vartheta\in\Theta(X)$ to points of $X$) and, for each $x\in X$ and $r\in\mathbb R$, a pseudometric $d_{x,r}$ on $\Theta(X)$ (with extended version $ ar d_{x,r}$), together with the further compatibility axioms of `CompatibleFunctions`; and the condition that $K$ is a one-sided Calderón–Zygmund kernel (`IsOneSidedKernel a K`): $K$ is measurable, $|K(x,y)|\le C_K(a)/V(x,y)$ for all $x,y\in X$, and $|K(x,y)-K(x,y')|\le (d(y,y')/d(x,y))^{1/a}\,C_K(a)/V(x,y)$ whenever $2d(y,y')\le d(x,y)$, where $C_K(a)=2^{a^3}$ and $V(x,y)=\mu(B(x,d(x,y)))$ (as a real number). Assume moreover that $\Theta(X)$ is $	frac1a$-cancellative (`IsCancellative X (defaultτ a)`, with $\mathrm{defaultτ}(a)=1/a$): for all $x\in X$, $r>0$, $\varphi:X	o\mathbb C$ with $\|\varphi\|_{\mathrm{Lip}(x,r)}<\infty$ and $\{\varphi
e0\}\subseteq B(x,r)$, and all $\vartheta,\vartheta'\in\Theta(X)$, $ ig|\int_X e^{i(\vartheta(y)-\vartheta'(y))}\varphi(y)\,d\mu(y) ig|\le 2^a\mu(B(x,r))\,\|\varphi\|_{\mathrm{Lip}(x,r)}\,(1+ ar d_{x,r}(\vartheta,\vartheta'))^{-1/a}$, where $\|\varphi\|_{\mathrm{Lip}(x,r)}=\sup_{B(x,r)}|\varphi|+r\sup_{y
e y'\in B(x,r)}|\varphi(y)-\varphi(y')|/d(y,y')\in[0,\infty]$.

Let $q,q'\in\mathbb R_{\ge0}$, $F\subseteq X$, $f:X	o\mathbb C$ and $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X	o\mathbb Z$. An element of the project structure $\mathrm{CP304}(q,q',F,f,\sigma_1,\sigma_2)$ (per its docstring, the parameters that stay constant throughout the recursive calls to finitary Carleson in the proof of Lemma 3.0.4) consists of a simple function $Q:X	o\Theta(X)$ (its field `CP304.Q`) such that: for every $	heta\in\Theta(X)$ the operator $T_Q^	heta$ (`linearizedNontangentialOperator Q θ K`; per its docstring, the linearized maximally truncated nontangential Calderón–Zygmund operator), $T_Q^	heta g(x)=\sup_{R_2\in\mathbb R}\ \sup_{0<R_1<R_2}\ \sup_{x'\in B(x,R_1)} ig|\int_{\{y:\,R_1<d(x',y)<\min(R_2,R_Q(	heta,x'))\}}K(x',y)g(y)\,d\mu(y) ig|$ with $R_Q(	heta,x')=\sup\{r\in\mathbb R: d_{x',r}(	heta,Q(x'))<1\}\in[0,\infty]$, has bounded strong type $(2,2)$ with constant $2^{a^3}$ (`HasBoundedStrongType … 2 2 volume volume (C_Ts a)`): for every $g:X	o\mathbb C$ that is essentially bounded and a.e.-strongly measurable with support $\{g
e0\}$ of finite $\mu$-measure (`BoundedFiniteSupport`), $T_Q^	heta g$ is a.e.-strongly measurable and $\|T_Q^	heta g\|_{L^2(\mu)}\le 2^{a^3}\|g\|_{L^2(\mu)}$; $q\in(1,2]$; $q$ and $q'$ are Hölder conjugate ($1/q+1/q'=1$); $F$ is bounded and measurable; $f$ is measurable with $|f(x)|\le\mathbf 1_F(x)$ for all $x$; $\sigma_1,\sigma_2$ are measurable with finite ranges and $\sigma_1\le\sigma_2$ pointwise. An element of the project structure $\mathrm{P304}(q,q',F,f,\sigma_1,\sigma_2)$ (per its docstring, all the parameters needed to apply the recursion of Lemma 3.0.4) consists of an element $\mathrm{CP}\in\mathrm{CP304}(q,q',F,f,\sigma_1,\sigma_2)$ (field `P304.CP`) together with a bounded measurable set $G\subseteq X$ (field `P304.G`; per its docstring, the set being recursed on). For a simple function $Q:X	o\Theta(X)$ let $T_{\mathrm{lin}}g(x)=\sum_{s\in\mathbb Z,\ \sigma_1(x)\le s\le\sigma_2(x)}\int_X K_s(x,y)\,g(y)\,e^{i\,Q(x)(y)}\,d\mu(y)$ (`T_lin Q σ₁ σ₂ g x`, i.e. `T_S Q (σ₁ x) (σ₂ x) g x`; per its docstring, the operator $T_{2,\sigma_1,\sigma_2}$ of Lemma 3.0.4), where $K_s(x,y)=K(x,y)\,\psi(D^{-s}d(x,y))$ (`Ks`), $D=2^{𝕔a^2}$ with $𝕔\in\mathbb N$ the project constant `𝕔` (per its docstring, fixed equal to $100$), and $\psi(r)=\max(0,\min(1,4Dr-1,2-4r))$. Let $C_{2.0.1}(a,q)=C_{2.0.2}(a,q)=2^{(3𝕔+17+5\lfloor𝕔/4floor)a^3}/(q-1)^5\in\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ (`C2_0_1 a q`, computed in $\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ with truncated subtraction). The definition `P304.succ` sends $P\in\mathrm{P304}(q,q',F,f,\sigma_1,\sigma_2)$, with data $\mathrm{CP}$ (simple function $Q_{\mathrm{CP}}$) and set $G_P$, to the element of $\mathrm{P304}(q,q',F,f,\sigma_1,\sigma_2)$ with the same $\mathrm{CP}$ and with set $G'$, where $G'\subseteq X$ is a set chosen (by choice, from a proof that one exists) such that $G'\subseteq G_P$, $G'$ is bounded and measurable, $2\mu(G')\le\mu(G_P)$, and $\int_{G_P\setminus G'}|T_{\mathrm{lin}}f(x)|\,d\mu(x)\le C_{2.0.1}(a,q)\,\mu(G_P)^{1/q'}\,\mu(F)^{1/q}$ (built with $Q=Q_{\mathrm{CP}}$; lower Lebesgue integral, inequality in $[0,\infty]$) (per its docstring, this constructs $G_{n+1}$ given $G_n$). Thus `P304.succ` is the map $\mathrm{P304}(q,q',F,f,\sigma_1,\sigma_2)	o\mathrm{P304}(q,q',F,f,\sigma_1,\sigma_2)$, $P\mapsto(\mathrm{CP},G')$ described above.
